Anyone who can reach this machine has full control of its

nobody uses it. If needed remotely, put it behind a VPN.
This is how WannaCry and NotPetya spread through networks.
FixTurn it off — almost nothing still needs it.
Check very old scanners and NAS boxes first.

No longer receives security updates, so any vulnerability stays…
